biography:
I am a Utilities Delivery Director at QTS, a global leader in data center development and operation. With an EIT certification and an MBA in Executive Leadership, I have more than 25 years of experience in the energy sector, managing and delivering complex and high-impact power infrastructure projects across the Americas.

My core competencies include project management, engineering, contract negotiation, permitting, risk analysis, and relationship building. I lead the utilities due diligence, strategy, execution, and delivery for potential and existing data center sites, ensuring reliable and sustainable power for our customers and stakeholders. I also develop and maintain a multi-year spending plan, prioritize and oversee project scopes, costs, schedules, and quality, and foster a culture of innovation, collaboration, and excellence within my team and organization. I am passionate about providing power to everyone, and I constantly seek new ways to improve the efficiency, quality, and safety of our facilities and processes.
